name: Ara'vitu'urhal

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

On destruction, instead of splitting into two smaller Blue Horrors, The Daemon masquerading as Aru'vitu'urhal escapes back to the warp in a blinding explosion of warpfire and light. Blinding Warp Explosion: 5+ 4ED/ Agonising, Blast (6), Inflict (Blinded) (no range printed).

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: The Changeling in disguise. No BONUSES or ABILITIES header is printed; the Battlecry sits under BONUSES. Heading prints 'ARA'VITU'URHAL', text 'Aru'vitu'urhal'. 'Blinding Warp Explosion' prints damage '5+' and no range.
